instruction: What is the title of the most-liked song in my Spotify playlists.
notes: Read-only question task: no mutating actions exist in the domain, so 'no model changes' holds by construction. The supervisor email (username) is obtained via supervisor.show_profile, the spotify password via show_account_passwords. show_playlist_library (paginated at runtime) collects song_ids of all library playlists; show_song is modeled with one abstract song object standing for every collected song id (the agent calls it once per id and compares like_count). The object most-liked-playlist-song denotes whichever song turns out to have the highest like_count, and its title is passed as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, which is forced last by (not (task-completed)) preconditions on every action.
